This is a standalone archive of all 19 interactive Shinylive apps in *[Elements of Statistical Computation](../compstat_book/index.html)*. Each app runs entirely in your browser: the R code is compiled to WebAssembly and executed locally by [webR](https://docs.r-wasm.org/webr/latest/), so nothing is sent to a server and no R installation is needed.

Pick an app from the table below. Every page also carries the app's full R source and a link back to the section of the book that explains it. The first load of an app takes a few seconds while webR downloads.

| App | Category |
|:----------------------------------------|:------------------|
| [Inverse CDF Method for Generating Random Numbers](app_inverse-cdf.html) | Monte Carlo Methods |
| [Newton-Raphson for the Cauchy Location Likelihood](app_cauchy-newton.html) | Optimization Algorithms |
| [Safeguarded Newton-Raphson for Logistic Regression](app_nr-divergence.html) | Optimization Algorithms |
| [Gradient-Based Methods for Minimizing Test Functions](app_gradient-methods.html) | Optimization Algorithms |
| [Gradient-Based Methods for Fitting a Gaussian Neural Network](app_sgd.html) | Optimization Algorithms |
| [Gradient-Based Methods for Fitting a Poisson Neural Network](app_nn-poisson.html) | Optimization Algorithms |
| [Nelder–Mead Method for Derivative-Free Minimization](app_nelder-mead.html) | Optimization Algorithms |
| [EM Algorithm for a Normal Mixture](app_mixture.html) | EM Algorithms |
| [EM Algorithm for a Bivariate Normal Mixture](app_mixture-bvn.html) | EM Algorithms |
| [Conjugate Updating for Bayesian Posteriors](app_bayes-explorer.html) | Introduction to Bayesian Inference |
| [Quadrature and Laplace Approximation for the Marginal Likelihood of a Normal Mean](app_ML_unknown_mean.html) | Numerical Quadrature, Laplace Approximation |
| [Midpoint, Laplace and Laplace-Adapted Midpoint Rules for the Marginal Likelihood of Normal Data](app_ML_unknown_mean_sd.html) | Numerical Quadrature |
| [Rejection Sampling with a Laplace Envelope for the Normal Distribution](app_rejection.html) | Rejection Sampling |
| [Rejection Sampling with a Cauchy Envelope for the Gamma Distribution](app_gamma-rejection.html) | Rejection Sampling |
| [Adaptive Rejection Sampling for the Truncated Normal Distribution](app_ars_normal.html) | Rejection Sampling |
| [Adaptive Rejection Sampling on log X for the Truncated Gamma Distribution](app_ars-loggamma.html) | Rejection Sampling |
| [Importance Sampling for a Bimodal Distribution (Failure Example)](app_missed-mode.html) | Importance Sampling |
| [Importance Sampling with a Normal Proposal for Student-t Probabilities](app_t-is.html) | Importance Sampling |
| [Gibbs Sampling for the Cauchy Model with Unknown Location and Scale](app_gibbs_cauchy.html) | Markov Chain Monte Carlo |
| [Comprehensive MCMC Simulators by Chi Feng](https://chi-feng.github.io/mcmc-demo/app.html) (external) | Markov Chain Monte Carlo |
